posts.en:
oss-prompt-optimizer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Optimize a raw instruction into a professional four-section prompt (Role / Task / Context / Format) through the harness llm service, with a composer button, one-click undo, a prompt_optimize tool, and an auto-optimize hook.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0244723c0a12f6f44919.html
